docs.title: Sorrentino's Canadian Textbook for the Support Worker
docs.text:
Mary J. Wilk, Sheila A. Sorrentino, Leighann N. Remmert — Elsevier, 5th Canadian Edition (2022)

The comprehensive guide for personal support workers in Canada. Covers client-centred care, safety, communication, and clinical skills.

Part Topics Part 1 Role & Responsibilities, Canadian Health Care System, Workplace Settings, Ethics, Legislation Part 2 Health & Wellness, Culture & Diversity, Stress Management, Communication, Teamwork Part 3 Clients & Families, Abuse Awareness, Career Start, Body Mechanics, Exercise & Activity Part 4 Rehabilitation, Personal Hygiene, Grooming, Infection Prevention, Safety Part 5 Beds & Bed Making, Skin Care, Comfort & Pain, Vital Signs, Medical Terminology Part 6 Care Planning, Nutrition, Enteral Nutrition, Urinary Elimination, Bowel Elimination Part 7 Growth & Development, Body Structure & Function, Diseases & Disorders Part 8 Hearing & Vision, Speech & Language, Developmental Disorders, Mental Health Part 9 Dementia, Oxygenation, Heat & Cold, Infant & Child Care, Older Persons Part 10 Home Management, Medication Management, Acute Care, End-of-Life Care Part 11 Appendix, References, Procedures Part 12-19 Additional chapters and procedures

Key Concepts: DIPPS (Dignity, Independence, Individualized care, Preferences, Privacy, Safety), scope of practice, client-centred care, infection control, body mechanics, vital signs, care planning.

docs.title: The Human Body in Health and Illness
docs.text:
Barbara Herlihy — Elsevier, 7th Edition (2022)

Anatomy and physiology textbook with clinical correlations. Structure meets function with pathophysiology integrated throughout.

Part Topics Part 1 Introduction to the Human Body, Levels of Organization, Organ Systems, Homeostasis, Anatomical Terms Part 2 Basic Chemistry, Cells, Cell Metabolism Part 3 Microbiology Basics, Tissues and Membranes Part 4 Integumentary System, Body Temperature, Skeletal System Part 5 Muscular System, Nervous System (Brain & Nervous Tissue) Part 6 Spinal Cord, Peripheral Nerves, Autonomic Nervous System, Sensory System Part 7 Endocrine System, Blood Part 8 Heart Anatomy & Function, Blood Vessels, Circulation Part 9 Lymphatic System, Immune System, Respiratory System Part 10 Digestive System, Urinary System Part 11 Water, Electrolyte & Acid-Base Balance, Reproductive Systems Part 12 Human Development and Heredity Part 13 Answers, Glossary

Key Concepts: Homeostasis, structure-function relationships, 12 organ systems, anatomical terminology, pathophysiology, clinical correlations.

docs.title: Integrating a Palliative Approach
docs.text:
Katherine Murray — Life and Death Matters, 2nd Edition

Essentials for personal support workers providing palliative and end-of-life care.

Part Topics Part 1 Understanding Dying, Palliative Approach, Preparing to Care Part 2 Standardized Tools, Supporting Physical Comfort Part 3 Psychosocial Care, Last Days and Hours Part 4 Self-Care for Caregivers, Grief, Cultural Safety

Key Concepts: Palliative approach, person-centred care, self-awareness, cultural safety, psychosocial support, end-of-life care, caregiver self-care.

docs.title: How to Use
docs.text:
1. Browse by textbook — Each book is organized into logical parts
  2. Search — Use GitHub's search (press /) to find specific topics across all files
  3. Cross-reference — Concepts link between books (e.g., body mechanics in Sorrentino's connects to musculoskeletal system in The Human Body)
  4. Study — Each part contains chapter summaries, key terms, and clinical correlations

docs.title: Local Setup & Obsidian Integration
docs.text:
To use this knowledge base locally with full graph visualization and instant search:

  1. Clone the repository: 

    git clone https://github.com/8LUEPRINT3/awesome-health-science-wiki.git

  2. Open in Obsidian:

  3. Launch Obsidian
  4. Click Open folder as vault

  5. Select the cloned awesome-health-science-wiki folder

  6. Explore:

  7. Use the Graph View to visualize connections between topics
  8. Use Ctrl/Cmd + Shift + F for full-text search across all textbooks
  9. Use Ctrl/Cmd + O to quickly jump to any file
